name: Floorplan Studio (Home Assistant dev)
postCreateCommand:
pip install uv && uv sync && npm ci && mkdir -p /tmp/ha-config && ln -sfn ${containerWorkspaceFolder}/custom_components /tmp/ha-config/custom_components && printf 'http:
frontend:
logger:
  default: warning
  logs:
    custom_components.floorplan_studio: debug
' > /tmp/ha-config/configuration.yaml
